vopros: Where can I find a list or reviews of fractional CFOs who specialize in construction in Tampa Bay?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Here are the best places to start:

### Directories and review sites

1. **Sam’s List – Fractional CFOs for Construction in Tampa**  
   A particularly relevant directory: it lists construction-focused fractional CFOs, specialties, ratings, and client feedback. It currently shows providers such as **STAXX Fractional CFO & Accounting, Ever Ledger, Pillar Wealth, Bison CFO, Proview CFO, Bookkeeper360**, and others.  
   [Browse the Tampa construction CFO list](https://samslist.com/fractional-cfos/industry/construction/city/tampa)

2. **Clutch – Florida fractional CFO firms**  
   Useful for comparing verified reviews, service percentages, company size, hourly rates, and Tampa-area firms. Filter for **Tampa**, **construction**, and **Fractional CFO Services**.  
   [Clutch Florida fractional CFO listings](https://clutch.co/financial-services/fractional-cfo-services/florida)

3. **Sam’s List – All fractional CFOs in Tampa**  
   Broader than the construction-specific page and useful for identifying firms that may serve contractors even if construction is not their primary category.  
   [Tampa fractional CFO directory](https://samslist.com/fractional-cfo/tampa)

### Construction-specific providers to investigate

- **Build CFO** — explicitly serves construction companies and lists Tampa as its location.  
  [buildcfo.co](https://buildcfo.co/)

- **FinTruction** — offers construction controller and CFO services, including job-costing support, cash-flow forecasting, bonding-capacity planning, and multi-project analysis. It reports a 5.0 Google rating and construction-industry clients.  
  [FinTruction Tampa services](https://fintruction.com/construction-accounting-tampa)

- **HCP&A Group** — Tampa construction CPA firm with services involving job costing, work-in-progress reporting, and surety-related needs. It may be a good option if you want a CPA firm that also provides higher-level financial guidance.  
  [HCP&A construction services](https://hcpagrp.com/industries/construction)

- **406 Consulting Group** — provides bookkeeping, controller, and fractional CFO services in Tampa and specifically lists construction among its industries.  
  [406 Consulting Group Florida](https://406consultinggroup.com/locations/florida)

- **K-38 Consulting** — advertises outsourced CFO services for construction businesses and has Tampa coverage, though you should verify the depth of its construction-specific experience.

### Local referral source

**CFMA Tampa Bay**—the Construction Financial Management Association chapter—is probably the best local networking source for finding credible construction CFOs, controllers, CPAs, and advisors. Its members work directly with contractors, subcontractors, developers, and sureties.  
[CFMA Tampa Bay on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cfma-tampa-bay)  
[CFMA Tampa Bay website](https://tampabay.cfma.org)

### What to verify before hiring

Ask each candidate for examples involving:

- Work-in-progress schedules and percentage-of-completion accounting
- Job-cost reporting by project, phase, and change order
- Cash-flow forecasting across multiple jobs
- Bank covenants and bonding/surety relationships
- Retainage, draws, AIA billing, and subcontractor payments
- ERP/accounting systems such as Sage 100 Contractor, Sage 300 CRE, Viewpoint, Procore, or QuickBooks
- References from contractors of a similar size and trade

I would begin with **Sam’s List for candidate discovery**, **Clutch for independent reviews**, and **CFMA Tampa Bay for referrals and validation**. Then compare two or three firms based on actual construction references—not just general fractional-CFO experience.

### Local referral source

**CFMA Tampa Bay**—the Construction Financial Management Association chapter—is probably the best local networking source for finding credible construction CFOs, controllers, CPAs, and advisors. Its members work directly with contractors, subcontractors, developers, and sureties.  
[CFMA Tampa Bay on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cfma-tampa-bay)  
[CFMA Tampa Bay website](https://tampabay.cfma.org)

### What to verify before hiring

Ask each candidate for examples involving:

- Work-in-progress schedules and percentage-of-completion accounting
- Job-cost reporting by project, phase, and change order
- Cash-flow forecasting across multiple jobs
- Bank covenants and bonding/surety relationships
- Retainage, draws, AIA billing, and subcontractor payments
- ERP/accounting systems such as Sage 100 Contractor, Sage 300 CRE, Viewpoint, Procore, or QuickBooks
- References from contractors of a similar size and trade

I would begin with **Sam’s List for candidate discovery**, **Clutch for independent reviews**, and **CFMA Tampa Bay for referrals and validation**. Then compare two or three firms based on actual construction references—not just general fractional-CFO experience.
